commits.subject: core: TJsonWriter.AddEscapeBuffer() did read beyond the input buffer
commits.body:
The MaxLen comparison was inverted: 'MaxLen > Len' extended Len up to MaxLen
instead of truncating it. TSynLog.LogText() calls it with TextTruncateAtLength
for any invalid UTF-8 text - e.g. binary content logged via sllServiceReturn -
so the logger read up to MaxLen bytes of unrelated heap memory into the log
file, or raised an access violation while holding the log lock.

commits.subject: rest: only use the session cookie for HTTP-based authentication
commits.body:
TRestClientAuthentication.ClientGetSessionKey() took the first Set-Cookie
header of the auth response as session ID for any non signed-URI scheme.
Behind a reverse proxy (e.g. Azure App Proxy) the first cookie may be the
proxy's own: a non-void IDHexa8 then skipped the PrivateKey computation in
SessionCreate() and every following signed request failed with 403.

- only TRestClientAuthenticationHttpAbstract transmits its session as cookie,
  so the cookie is only parsed for those schemes
- the server names its session cookie after Model.Root: search for it among
  all Set-Cookie headers and ignore any other cookie
